scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run check -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w cli
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/tests cli frontend/app frontend/next.config.ts scripts e2e playwright.config.ts README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend/src backend/tests cli frontend/app frontend/next.config.ts scripts e2e playwright.config.ts README.md
